error_message: Remote service rejected the request signature for the active principal.
The provider says the caller identity is no longer accepted for this resource.
Request identity proof could not be validated by the upstream service.
The account principal attached to this request lacks permission to access the object.
Provider burst budget exhausted; additional calls are deferred until the next window.
Request allowance for this minute has been consumed and the service rejected the call.
The upstream concurrency budget is saturated and new work is being refused temporarily.
Provider usage window is exhausted; calls can resume after capacity resets.
The upstream exceeded its 30 second service window and the gateway ended the request.
No response arrived before the connector's maximum response window elapsed.
The remote operation remained incomplete beyond the configured latency budget.
Gateway closed the request after the upstream failed to answer within its service deadline.
TLS peer closed the transport before any response headers were received.
TCP handshake to the upstream host could not complete.
The socket path to the remote host became unavailable before the request was delivered.
Secure channel negotiation terminated unexpectedly before application data was exchanged.
Template lookup produced null for customerId even though the downstream step expects a value.
JSON selector resolved to an empty collection while the node expected one record.
Previous step emitted a nested object where this field expects a scalar string.
Iterator index points to a record that is absent from the incoming batch.
Incoming callback path has no active registration for live traffic.
The live callback endpoint is not mounted for the currently active automation.
External callback reached a route that this automation has not exposed in live mode.
Callback delivery failed because the listening endpoint is absent from the active deployment.
Selected operation is not supported for the connector mode chosen on this node.
Request body shape violates the contract of the selected connector action.
Resource identifier format is incompatible with the operation selected on this node.
Node is set to binary transfer mode while the preceding step supplies JSON objects only.
Vendor returned internal condition XJ-17 and provided no additional diagnostic context.
Remote system aborted processing with opaque code ZETA_901.
Connector stopped after receiving an undocumented provider state transition.
Upstream rejected the operation for an unspecified internal policy condition.
